item: Row 467: the candidate-sources evidence counts what the verdict reads and counts quarantined and undated articles apart
summary: The evidence block maintainers read before adding a source to a catalogue counted every non-newsletter article, quarantined ones included, and took a published date later than the export as the newest article. articles_stored now counts non-quarantined articles only, first_article and last_article are the source's own dated articles (published at or before the export's time, R845's rule), and two additive fields say what was left out: articles_quarantined and articles_undated. Same grouped read per 500 ids; schema label unchanged (additive). No strings, no schema change, no egress.
